research_mode: official ONS and Home Office sources only; outcome cohort and closed-period semantics, timeliness and Crimsec4 limits, open-data schema and revision states, geography editions and current outcome snapshots; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Supplementary metric unavailable-data state
verified_claims: an empty supplementary-metric value can mean data not available
this state is distinct from suppression and no-data-to-calculate
the reason field preserves the distinction
limitations: unavailable data is not negative evidence
availability can change in later editions

sources.name: Supplementary metric extraction-version contract
verified_claims: supplementary metric data are correct at the time of extraction
the user guide states they are subject to future revisions
force-level values therefore require an extraction date
limitations: later editions can change earlier periods
current extraction is not immutable ground truth

sources.name: Outcome-open-data duplicate correction
verified_claims: the update history records a 5 August 2025 correction to year-ending March 2022 outcomes data
duplicate lines were removed from the dataset
the correction changed a historical edition
limitations: pre-correction copies must not be silently mixed with corrected files
deduplication requires edition evidence

sources.name: Supplementary-metrics historical revision
verified_claims: the 5 August 2025 update revised supplementary outcomes metrics
the revision concerned 2021 to 2022 data
the update was published separately from the duplicate-line correction
limitations: historical metrics are revision-prone
downstream caches need edition tracking

sources.name: Community Safety Partnership file split
verified_claims: the CSP open data was split into 2016 to 2020 and 2021 onward files
the update history says the split reduced file size
the prior combined file was removed
limitations: file partition changes can break fixed download paths
the split does not denote a methodological break

sources.name: Current outcomes-open-data edition
verified_claims: the page lists an outcomes open-data file for year ending March 2026
the current file is an Excel workbook
prior annual editions remain separately listed
limitations: file size and schema can differ by edition
the workbook is aggregate open data rather than parcel evidence

sources.name: Historical outcomes file boundary
verified_claims: outcomes for year ending March 2006 through year ending March 2014 are supplied in a separate ODS file
post-2014 annual outcomes are listed as separate workbooks
the historical boundary overlaps the outcomes-framework transition
limitations: cross-boundary analysis requires schema and framework mapping
the historical file is not directly interchangeable with current workbooks

sources.name: Police-force-area open-data series
verified_claims: the page supplies police-recorded-crime PFA tables from year ending March 2013 onward
earlier periods are supplied in separate files
the PFA series is distinct from CSP data
limitations: PFA aggregates are not LSOA or parcel values
historical file boundaries require versioned joins

sources.name: PFA and CSP geography description
verified_claims: ONS publishes police-recorded-crime figures by Police Force Area
the dataset also includes Community Safety Partnership areas
CSP areas equate to local authorities in the majority of instances
limitations: majority equivalence is not universal identity
neither geography is an exact parcel boundary

sources.name: PFA dataset quarterly editions
verified_claims: the dataset retains editions for year ending March June September and December periods
each edition is a separate downloadable workbook
edition labels identify the reporting window
limitations: quarterly editions can revise overlapping annual periods
the edition date must be retained
